verdict.rationale: Kit documents bounce data in two forms: an account-level bounce rate over the last 90 days [kit-docs-63] and a `subscriber.bounced` webhook event [kit-docs-55]. It also reports DMARC status for sending addresses [kit-docs-41]. However, the per-broadcast stats endpoint lists only recipients, opens, clicks and unsubscribes, with no bounces [kit-docs-36], so per-send deliverability signals are not shown. Missing for 10: per-send bounce stats, spam complaint signals, blocklist monitoring, and actionable guidance when deliverability degrades.
